summary: Psalter opens with two ways: blessed man who does not walk in counsel of wicked nor stand in way of sinners nor sit in seat of scoffers, but delights in Torah of Yahweh meditating day and night, like tree planted by streams, leaf not withering, whatever he does prospers. Not so wicked — like chaff wind drives away, will not stand in judgment.
whyItMatters: Gateway to Psalms — sets choice: Torah as tree vs chaff. Introduces blessed life not as luck but rootedness, and warns wicked's way perishes. Sets up Psalm 2 anointed king, together as intro to whole book.

context.author: Anonymous, possibly later editor
context.literaryForm: Wisdom psalm, like Proverbs, with two ways imagery

outline.heading: Negative — what blessed man does not: walk, stand, sit with wicked
Positive — delights in Torah, meditates day and night
Image — tree planted by streams, not withering
Contrast — wicked like chaff wind drives
Summary — Yahweh knows way of righteous, way of wicked perishes

keyVerses.text: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;
keyVerses.why: Threefold not walk/stand/sit shows deepening involvement in wicked path — progression.

keyVerses.text: but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
keyVerses.why: Delight not duty — meditation, not just reading.

keyVerses.text: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

questions.question: What does 'blessed' mean here? Is it prosperity gospel?
questions.answer: Hebrew ashrei — flourishing, fortunate, in right place, like Beatitudes later. Not promise of wealth — tree prospers as in bears fruit in season, not always easy. Contrast with chaff — weightless, driven. Blessed is rootedness leading to life, not lucky break.

questions.question: Why walk, stand, sit — is movement important?
questions.answer: Three postures show progressive entanglement: walk in counsel (listen to advice), stand in way (join lifestyle), sit in seat of scoffers (settle as mocker). Wicked → sinners → scoffers intensifies. Shows how path forms by small steps. Alternative: delight, meditate, planted — different root.

questions.question: What does 'meditates day and night' mean? Is it emptying mind?
questions.answer: Hebrew hagah — mutter, murmur, like cow chewing cud, not emptying but filling — reciting Torah low, pondering. Day and night = continually, habit, not literal 24-hour. For zero-background: like memorizing song lyric that plays in mind, shaping reactions. Delight precedes meditation — love drives habit.

questions.question: Why tree planted by streams vs chaff?
questions.answer: Tree intentionally planted (not wild), by water channels (irrigated), evergreen leaf not withering, fruit in season, prospers — image of stability and nourishment. Chaff = husk winnowed, light, wind blows away, no root, no weight to stand in judgment. One has rootedness, other weightlessness. Jeremiah 17:7-8 reuses image.

questions.question: What does 'Yahweh knows the way of righteous' mean? Does he not know wicked?
questions.answer: Know = yada — intimate, watchful, cares for, acknowledges. Knows way of righteous = attends, approves. Way of wicked perishes — not just they perish, but way itself perishes, no future. Two ways theology appears later in Matthew 7 narrow/wide gates and Psalm 1 as Torah's choice (Deut 30).

glossary.def: Flourishing, fortunate, in right place — not just happy feeling.
Instruction, guidance — not just rules but teaching shaping life.
Mutter, murmur, chew cud — reciting and pondering text.
